raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Adds the Triton fused-MoE tile config for Gemma 4 26B-A4B (BF16, `E=128,N=704`) on AMD Instinct MI350P (gfx950, 128 CUs). MI350P has no config for this shape today, so vLLM logs `Using default MoE config` and runs the default tiles. Config file only.

## Claims

- `google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it` on 1x MI350P with vLLM's Triton fused MoE: peak prefill throughput +2.9% (8000 in / 50 out), +3 to +4% at concurrency 8-64.
- Tradeoff: prefill at concurrency 2 and 4 is lower (-14%, -5%), and decode (50 in / 4096 out) is 1-4% lower at every concurrency, -0.8% at the decode peak.
- GSM8K unchanged (0.948 vs 0.951). One run per arm; a repeat is pending before this leaves draft.

## Validation

One run per arm, same image and GPU; the arms differ only in `VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER` pointing at this file. Peak over the concurrency sweep:

| Workload (1x MI350P, TP1) | Default tiles | This config | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prefill 8000/50, total tok/s, concurrency 2-64 | 50,911 | 52,381 | +2.9% |
| Decode 50/4096, output tok/s, concurrency 32-1024 | 11,537 | 11,449 | -0.8% |
| GSM8K 5-shot, strict match | 0.948 | 0.951 | |

<details>
<summary>Per-concurrency results</summary>

Prefill, total tok/s:

| Concurrency | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default tiles | 27,542 | 34,157 | 40,772 | 45,956 | 48,995 | 50,911 |
| This config | 23,649 | 32,465 | 41,962 | 47,423 | 50,722 | 52,381 |
| Change | -14.1% | -5.0% | +2.9% | +3.2% | +3.5% | +2.9% |

Decode, output tok/s:

| Concurrency | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 | 512 | 1024 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default tiles | 2,562 | 4,116 | 6,235 | 8,615 | 11,537 | 11,431 |
| This config | 2,470 | 3,940 | 5,959 | 8,386 | 11,449 | 11,231 |
| Change | -3.6% | -4.3% | -4.4% | -2.7% | -0.8% | -1.7% |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Reproduction</summary>

Image: vLLM nightly `335dd77b` (`vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-335dd77b09161c5d63139b4e7ae51bb9928305b1`) plus #53273, #58838, #53918 and ROCm/aiter main with ROCm/aiter#5504, #5505, #5848, #6877, #6844, #6295, #7218.

Server (add `VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER=<dir with this file>` for the config arm):

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --language-model-only \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --async-scheduling --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --compilation-config '{"use_inductor_graph_partition": true, "pass_config": {"fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache": true, "rope_kvcache_fusion_max_token_num": 33792}}'
```

Client, for each concurrency `C` (fixed seed per point):

```bash
# prefill, C = 2 4 8 16 32 64
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --endpoint /v1/completions --model google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8000 --random-output-len 50 --ignore-eos \
  --request-rate inf --max-concurrency $C --num-prompts $((4*C)) --num-warmups $C
# decode, C = 32 64 128 256 512 1024
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --endpoint /v1/completions --model google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 50 --random-output-len 4096 --ignore-eos \
  --request-rate inf --max-concurrency $C --num-prompts $C --num-warmups 32
```

Accuracy: `lm_eval --model local-chat-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --apply_chat_template` against the server's `/v1/chat/completions`.

Tuning: `benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_moe.py --model google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it --tp-size 1 --dtype auto --tune`, batch sizes 1 to 16384, on one MI350P.

</details>

## Details

- Why: on ROCm, Gemma 4's GELU-tanh MoE runs on vLLM's Triton `fused_moe` (AITER's fused MoE does not support it without #55251, and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` is off by default), so MI350P users get the default tiles for this shape.
- Limitation: the ROCm search space of `benchmark_moe.py` was cut to about 2.9k of ~26k configs (`BLOCK_K` without 16, `num_warps` 2/4/8, `GROUP_M` 1/8/16, `waves_per_eu` 0/2, `kpack` 2) to keep tuning time reasonable. The small-batch and decode losses above may come from that; a full-space retune of the small batch sizes is the next step if the repeat confirms them.
- The image also carries Gemma 4 fusion PRs (#53918, #53273, #58838) and the AITER MI350P PRs; none of them touch the Triton fused-MoE path, and both arms use the same image.
- CI has no MI350P; coverage is the runs above.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

Thanks for the fix!

Since the regresses decode and low conc prefill, can we check if we can fix this alt only include the configs for large M? 

I think also good to run for more than $CONC number of prompts, as you likely get very noisy measurements with a single conc worth of prompts
